name: gsap-flip-card
title: GSAP Flip Card
description: A card stack that expands into a hero image and thumbnail rail with GSAP Flip transitions.

props.name: stackOffsetX
props.description: Horizontal offset per card in the collapsed desktop stack.

props.name: stackOffsetY
props.description: Vertical offset per card in the collapsed desktop stack.

props.name: stackRotation
props.description: Rotation per card in the collapsed desktop stack, in degrees.

props.name: thumbGap
props.description: Spacing between desktop rail thumbnails in pixels.

props.name: captionFadeDuration
props.description: Fade-out duration in seconds for all text sections.

props.name: captionRevealDuration
props.description: Line-reveal duration in seconds for all text sections.

props.name: captionLineStagger
props.description: Stagger between revealed lines across all text sections in seconds.

props.name: title
props.description: Fallback title for items without a title.

props.name: meta
props.description: Fallback metadata for items without metadata.

props.name: description
props.default: A pile of cards that fans into a hero and a rail. Tap any frame and the two trade places, same nodes, measured and tweened, never re-mounted.
props.description: Fallback description for items without a description.

props.name: items
props.description: Gallery images with optional IDs, alt text, titles, metadata, descriptions and captions; defaults to the built-in gallery.
